title: Decode failures built with JevError::encode_failed carry an encode-side retry hint
description: CheckRequest::parse maps every serde failure to JevError::encode_failed (v1.rs:563-564). The same pattern is in CanonicalJudgePayload::from_bytes (payload.rs:408-409). The code is INPUT_INVALID, as the ADR requires. But the EncodeFailed hint reads 'could not be encoded as JSON ... Retry; if it persists, report it as a bug' (error.rs:833). That is the wrong guidance for a malformed caller body or payload. Sprint item 9 asks for InputInvalid with a fix hint, and this is the opposite of a fix hint. The variant is also an encode-side recovery category in ADR-SAG-0027, and these are decode failures. I am not marking it Blocking because the ADR fixes only the code mapping, and ErrorCode, exit code and retryable() are all correct.
